data.budget: about 1.5 hours, read-only, no suite run
data.claim: ddflow's planned model (P-test-flows cards/results/trace, P-specs, P-requirements, P-user-stories, P-security-gate, P-toolkit, QA-*) already covers about 70 percent of a test-management data model; missing are: a test plan/cycle with checkable entry/exit criteria, a target-repo pointer and QA-project profile, defect fields for escape/DRE and a forge export, manual-execution step results with evidence, spec-to-test derivation with an encodes-the-spec check, readiness/traceability reports, environment safety classes, and the infra/supply-chain/DAST/compliance checks. Build them as thin layers on existing records, not a second tracker.
data.falsifier: A seeded sample target project cannot go from spec to go/no-go report using only these records, or the TM-accept run needs a new record kind besides plan/risk/charter documents; or operator rejects the QA-as-project mode in TM-decide.
data.mechanism: Map each ISTQB-style artifact to an existing ddflow kind: test case = TF-card pointing at code, run = TF-record, requirement = story/spec criterion, defect = bug record, plan = doc type, criteria = RQM-check style verify, scanners = ADP-tools/SEC-scanners/TK-sarif; only the missing joins become tasks (TM-*, DS-*).
data.probe: ddflow list/show of P-test-flows, P-specs, P-requirements, P-user-stories, P-security-gate, P-toolkit, P-qa-evidence tasks; find/grep over tests/ (980 test_*.py files, 10894 static test defs, 11 files using hypothesis, 8 using mark.slow, 43 mentioning golden, 23 guard/ratchet/census/arch files, tests/guard_baselines 72 files, tests/fixtures 126, tests/compat 12, tests/property 4, demos/ 6 scenarios); pyproject markers slow and scenarios, addopts -m not slow; ci.yml jobs tests,quality(gitleaks,bandit,ruff),codeql,compat,scenarios; WebFetch of kiwitcms, pact, schemathesis, slsa, arxiv 2501.12862, SARIF 2.1.0, playwright test-agents, cyclonedx, dora, allure testops, nist ssdf
data.probe_output: Static counts only, no suite run. 1149 bug records exist. live_test is in gates.phase_pipeline with only an onboarding proposal (services/onboard_tests.py), no runner. No SBOM/trivy/checkov/terraform/hadolint/cosign code in ddflow/ (grep: only docs and precommit mention). Flake log is local-only (.ddflow/local/flakes.jsonl). ExternalTool port ADP-tools done; ADP-forge open but unblocked. Doc-type engine B-dt-validate done. TF-record/TF-card/TF-trace chain is long (needs B-pi-scenario-card/run, SE-globs, TF-kinds, P-extension-seams.registry). External facts verified by fetch 2026-11-03: Kiwi TCMS 16.6 run/execution model; CycloneDX 1.7 (2025-10-21, ECMA-424); SLSA v1.1 build L0-L3; SARIF 2.1.0 errata01 2023-08-28; DORA five metrics; Playwright planner/generator/healer; Meta ACH 73 percent accepted, 9095 mutants/10795 classes; Fucci 2016 replication no significant TDD difference p .27/.82/.83; arXiv 2406.18181 LLM tests miss defects mostly for missing trigger inputs 74.99 percent.
data.question: How can ddflow manage test workflows and act as a test/QA project for another project (plans, cases from specs, runs, defects, reports, deployment/infra and devsecops checks), what exists or is planned, and what is missing?
